hints.content: The alternating series error test tells that the error bound is given by the first omitted term of the series.  In this case, that means the error bound is $~\displaystyle\frac{{{\left( -1 \right)}^{4}}}{7!} \approx0.000198$.
Since the error bound is a positive number, the approximation must be less than the actual value.  Hence, the partial sum is an underestimate.

In conclusion, The error bound is 
*positive* and hence the approximation is an *underestimate*.

The absolute value of the error bound, rounded to six decimal places, is $0.000198$.
